title: もしもあなたが、江戸の長屋で1日暮らしたら。部屋は6畳で風呂なし #もしも #日本史 #江戸時代
promise: 江戸の町人が住んだ九尺二間の長屋は土間込みで6畳ほど、井戸と便所は長屋のみんなで使い、風呂は家に無く湯屋に通った。天保の改革で湯銭は大人8文に決められ、1杯16文といわれる屋台のそばの半分だった、と人に話せる。
desc:
あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？ コメントで教えてください。

※今の人（あなた）が江戸の長屋で1日暮らす話と、隣の鳶の親方のセリフは作り話です。九尺二間の長屋の広さ、井戸・便所・ごみためを住人みんなで使ったこと、江戸の庶民は家に湯殿が無く湯屋（銭湯）に通ったこと、天保の改革で湯銭が大人8文に決められたこと、そばが1杯16文といわれることは史実をもとにしています。
※映像とナレーションはAIを使って作っています。
style: 劇画寄りの歴史漫画。太く力強い主線、陰の濃い塗り、行灯と夕日の暖かい色。縦長で1枚の絵に1つの場面（コマ割り・上下2分割にしない・枠を付けない）。大事な物は画面の縦30〜65%・真ん中。絵の中に文字を入れない
avoid: 絵の中の文字・数字・ロゴ・看板の字、コマ割り、枠、吹き出し、血・けが
world_rules: 作り話は1つだけ：今の人（あなた）が1人、天保のころの江戸の裏長屋で1日暮らす。長屋の広さ・井戸と便所の共用・家に風呂が無いこと・湯屋の数・湯銭8文・そば16文は史実のまま
あなたは今の暮らし（家に風呂とトイレがある）を知っている。江戸の湯屋の場所と湯銭は、隣の親方に聞くまで知らない
鳶の親方（隣に住む江戸の人）は、湯屋の場所と湯銭（8文）を町の常識として知っている。今の暮らし・メートル・天保の改革という呼び名・湯屋の軒数は知らない。親方のセリフ（n09）は湯屋の場所と湯銭だけを言う
「2.7m」「3.6m」「6畳」「4畳」「600軒」「天保の改革」「16文といわれる」「その半分」「そば半分」「そば1杯より安かった」は、語り手が言う文。あなたは声を出さない（セリフは親方の1カットだけ）
facts: 九尺二間は、間口九尺（約2.7メートル）奥行二間（約3.6メートル）の家で、江戸時代、最も狭い住居の大きさ。転じて裏長屋をいう。出どころ：精選版 日本国語大辞典・デジタル大辞泉「九尺二間」（kotobank.jp/word/九尺二間、2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）。1.5間×2間＝3坪＝6畳ほど（計算）
裏店（裏長屋）は、長屋1戸が間口9尺・奥行2間（俗に9尺2間の棟割長屋）が標準で、一画には住人共用の井戸・便所・ごみためが必ずまとまって置かれていた。住人は大工・左官・桶職などの職人、棒手振の小商人、鳶や其日稼の者など。出どころ：改訂新版 世界大百科事典「裏店」・世界大百科事典（旧版）「長屋」（kotobank.jp/word/裏店、2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）
最小の九尺二間の棟割長屋は面積約9.72m2で、入口の土間に水がめ・流し・かまど、奥に4畳余りの居間兼寝室。路地の奥に共同の井戸・便所・ごみ溜め。出どころ：磯田道史 監修『新版 江戸の家計簿』（宝島社）の抜粋 president.jp/articles/-/85985（2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）
江戸時代には、上士屋敷とか大家以外は自家内に湯殿の設備がないので、一般庶民はすべて銭湯を利用した。出どころ：日本大百科全書（ニッポニカ）「銭湯」（kotobank.jp/word/銭湯、2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）

江戸の湯屋は天保以降、幕末まで約600軒。湯銭は大人10文くらいだったが、天保の改革（天保12年＝1841年の府命）で大人8文・子供6文・小児4文に定められた（喜田川守貞『守貞謾稿』をもとにした解説）。出どころ：nippon.com「お江戸銭湯よもやま話：『守貞漫稿』（その10）」 www.nippon.com/ja/japan-topics/g01098/（2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）

史料の本文：『諸事留』[8] 天保度御改正 諸事留 二（国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション 2547389・請求記号 803-11）に「天保十三寅年二月廿九日 町々湯屋共御趣意に付湯銭八文…」とある（国立国会図書館 次世代デジタルライブラリーの全文検索 lab.ndl.go.jp で OCR の本文を確認）。2026-11-05 にページの画像（IIIF）も見た：表紙で書名・巻・請求記号を確かめ、コマ40・44・47・50・53 の朱書きの日付が天保十三寅年二月十八日→廿五日→廿七日と進み、コマ53 の湯屋の記事の1行目に「八文」の字を見た。くずし字のため、湯銭の一文を一字ずつ読み切ることはできなかった。台本は『天保の改革で大人8文に決められた』とだけ言い、年は言わない
二八そばは、江戸末期、1杯16文であるところから『二八、一六』とも考えられた。出どころ：精選版 日本国語大辞典・デジタル大辞泉・世界の料理がわかる辞典「二八蕎麦」（kotobank.jp/word/二八蕎麦、2026-11-05 に本文を読んで確認）。台本は『といわれる』

cuts.narration: あなたの江戸の部屋には、風呂もトイレも無い。
cuts.image_en: First-person view from the eyes of a modern visitor: the viewer's own two hands, in plain grey modern sleeves, slide open a worn paper sliding door of an Edo-period back-alley row house, revealing one tiny dim room with a small dirt-floor entry, a clay water jar, a small stove and a few worn tatami mats, no bath anywhere. The viewer's face is never shown.
cuts.image: First-person view from the eyes of a modern visitor: the viewer's own two hands, in plain grey modern sleeves, slide open a worn paper sliding door of an Edo-period back-alley row house, revealing one tiny dim room with a small dirt-floor entry, a clay water jar, a small stove and a few worn tatami mats, no bath anywhere. The viewer's face is never shown.

cuts.narration: その代わり、町の風呂は、そば1杯より安かった。
cuts.tts_text: その代わり、町の風呂は、そばいっぱいより安かった。
cuts.image_en: First-person view on an Edo-period street at dusk: the viewer's own open palm in a plain grey modern sleeve holds a few small round copper coins with square holes, and just ahead at the street corner the low wooden entrance of a big public bathhouse glows warmly with white steam rising from its roof. No writing on any curtain or lantern.
cuts.image: First-person view on an Edo-period street at dusk: the viewer's own open palm in a plain grey modern sleeve holds a few small round copper coins with square holes, and just ahead at the street corner the low wooden entrance of a big public bathhouse glows warmly with white steam rising from its roof. No writing on any curtain or lantern.

cuts.narration: 部屋は九尺二間。間口2.7m、奥行き3.6m。
cuts.tts_text: 部屋は、くしゃくにけん。まぐちにてんななメートル、おくゆきさんてんろくメートル。
cuts.image_en: First-person view from the doorway into a very small Edo-period row-house room: the viewer's own arms in plain grey modern sleeves stretched out to both sides almost touch the two side walls; worn tatami, one small paper window, warm morning light.
cuts.image: First-person view from the doorway into a very small Edo-period row-house room: the viewer's own arms in plain grey modern sleeves stretched out to both sides almost touch the two side walls; worn tatami, one small paper window, warm morning light.

cuts.narration: 土間を入れて6畳ほど。寝る所は4畳ほど。
cuts.tts_text: 土間を入れて、ろくじょうほど。寝る所は、よじょうほど。
cuts.image_en: Looking down from above into a tiny Edo-period row-house room: a dirt-floor kitchen corner with a clay stove, a wooden sink and a water jar by the door, and behind it a small area of four worn tatami mats with a folded futon and a small wooden chest. No people.
cuts.image: Looking down from above into a tiny Edo-period row-house room: a dirt-floor kitchen corner with a clay stove, a wooden sink and a water jar by the door, and behind it a small area of four worn tatami mats with a folded futon and a small wooden chest. No people.

cuts.narration: 朝、路地の奥に、長屋みんなの井戸。
cuts.image_en: First-person view: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves pull a rope with a wooden bucket from a shared wooden well at the back of an Edo-period alley at morning, while several row-house women in plain kimono with sleeves tied up wash vegetables and rice around the well and glance at the viewer curiously.
cuts.image: First-person view: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves pull a rope with a wooden bucket from a shared wooden well at the back of an Edo-period alley at morning, while several row-house women in plain kimono with sleeves tied up wash vegetables and rice around the well and glance at the viewer curiously.

cuts.narration: 便所も、ごみための場所も、みんなと一緒。
cuts.image_en: The far end of a narrow Edo-period back alley in morning light: a small plain wooden shared outhouse with a half-height wooden door, a wooden refuse bin box beside it and the shared well, a row-house man in a plain kimono waiting his turn with arms folded. No writing anywhere.
cuts.image: The far end of a narrow Edo-period back alley in morning light: a small plain wooden shared outhouse with a half-height wooden door, a wooden refuse bin box beside it and the shared well, a row-house man in a plain kimono waiting his turn with arms folded. No writing anywhere.

cuts.narration: 隣は鳶の親方。向かいは大工。
cuts.tts_text: 隣は、とびの親方。向かいは大工。
cuts.image_en: First-person view in a narrow Edo-period back alley at morning: the Edo foreman steps out of the next row-house door tying his white headband and nods at the viewer, while across the alley an Edo-period carpenter in a plain brown work kimono shoulders a wooden toolbox and a saw.
cuts.image: First-person view in a narrow Edo-period back alley at morning: the Edo foreman steps out of the next row-house door tying his white headband and nods at the viewer, while across the alley an Edo-period carpenter in a plain brown work kimono shoulders a wooden toolbox and a saw.

cuts.narration: 夜、汗をかいたあなたは、部屋で風呂を探す。
cuts.image_en: First-person view at night inside a tiny Edo-period row-house room lit by one paper lantern with no writing: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves hold up a damp hand towel, looking around the bare room with only a stove, a water jar and tatami, no bath.
cuts.image: First-person view at night inside a tiny Edo-period row-house room lit by one paper lantern with no writing: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves hold up a damp hand towel, looking around the bare room with only a stove, a water jar and tatami, no bath.

cuts.narration: 湯屋なら、角を曲がってすぐだ。8文持ってきな。
cuts.tts_text: 湯屋なら、角を曲がってすぐだ。はちもん持ってきな。
cuts.image_en: At night in a narrow Edo-period back alley lit by a paper lantern with no writing, the Edo foreman leans in the doorway of the next row house, grinning and pointing down the alley with his thumb, a hand towel over his shoulder, looking straight at the viewer.
cuts.image: At night in a narrow Edo-period back alley lit by a paper lantern with no writing, the Edo foreman leans in the doorway of the next row house, grinning and pointing down the alley with his thumb, a hand towel over his shoulder, looking straight at the viewer.

cuts.narration: 町人の家に湯殿は無い。みんな湯屋へ通った。
cuts.tts_text: 町人の家に、ゆどのは無い。みんな、ゆやへ通った。
cuts.image_en: A crowded Edo-period public bathhouse interior drawn as an old woodblock-print scene: townsmen with hand towels washing at wooden buckets on a wet wooden floor, steam rising, a low wooden entrance to the hot bath at the back. Shoulders up only, modest.

real_src.題: File:Woman Relaxing after Her Bath, Utamaro, MET JP144.jpg

cuts.narration: 天保のころから幕末まで、江戸の湯屋は約600軒。
cuts.tts_text: てんぽうのころから幕末まで、江戸のゆやは、やくろっぴゃっけん。
cuts.image_en: A wide evening view over the tiled and shingled roofs of an Edo-period town at dusk, with thin columns of steam and smoke rising from bathhouse chimneys at many street corners, warm lantern light in the streets below.
cuts.image: A wide evening view over the tiled and shingled roofs of an Edo-period town at dusk, with thin columns of steam and smoke rising from bathhouse chimneys at many street corners, warm lantern light in the streets below.

cuts.narration: 湯銭は、天保の改革で大人8文に決められた。
cuts.tts_text: ゆせんは、てんぽうの改革で、大人はちもんに決められた。
cuts.image_en: First-person view at the raised wooden counter of an Edo-period bathhouse entrance at night: the viewer's own hand in a plain grey modern sleeve places a few small round copper coins with square holes into the open palm of the old bathhouse keeper sitting at the counter, steam behind a plain cloth curtain.
cuts.image: First-person view at the raised wooden counter of an Edo-period bathhouse entrance at night: the viewer's own hand in a plain grey modern sleeve places a few small round copper coins with square holes into the open palm of the old bathhouse keeper sitting at the counter, steam behind a plain cloth curtain.

cuts.narration: 屋台のそばは1杯16文といわれる。風呂はその半分。
cuts.tts_text: 屋台のそばは、いっぱいじゅうろくもんといわれる。風呂は、その半分。
cuts.image_en: First-person view at a night soba stall on an Edo street: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves hold a steaming bowl of soba with chopsticks in the foreground, and down the street behind it the warm glowing entrance of a bathhouse with steam rising, the stall vendor in a plain headband smiling. No writing on the lantern or curtains.
cuts.image: First-person view at a night soba stall on an Edo street: the viewer's own hands in plain grey modern sleeves hold a steaming bowl of soba with chopsticks in the foreground, and down the street behind it the warm glowing entrance of a bathhouse with steam rising, the stall vendor in a plain headband smiling. No writing on the lantern or curtains.

cuts.narration: 部屋は狭い。でも町に、そば半分の大きな風呂があった。
cuts.image_en: First-person view from inside a large steamy Edo-period bathhouse bath at night: the viewer's own hands rest on the wooden edge of a big hot tub, the Edo foreman soaking up to his shoulders beside the viewer, smiling with eyes closed, other townsmen in the steam. Shoulders up only.
cuts.image: First-person view from inside a large steamy Edo-period bathhouse bath at night: the viewer's own hands rest on the wooden edge of a big hot tub, the Edo foreman soaking up to his shoulders beside the viewer, smiling with eyes closed, other townsmen in the steam. Shoulders up only.

cuts.narration: あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？コメントで教えて。
cuts.image_en: First-person view walking back into a narrow Edo-period back alley at night with a damp hand towel over the viewer's own arm in a plain grey modern sleeve, paper lanterns with no writing glowing softly at the row-house doors, steam fading into the dark sky.
